_comments.usage: Copy this valid JSON template, edit values, and pass --home-config. _comments is documentation only. Paths are absolute or relative to the repository root. No legacy config files are read. Native OCHRE, home_factory, HPXML, schedules, weather and predictor models remain dependencies.
_comments.homes: Home IDs map to complete explicit home entries. This example includes home_01 only; duplicate a complete entry with unique home/EV IDs for more homes. Physical equipment/envelope not overridden here comes from the named HPXML, not legacy JSON.
_comments.simulation.start_time: Evaluation start, ISO local datetime aligned to plant step; HPWH scenario requires a quarter-hour. Plant/controllers start warmup_hours earlier.
_comments.simulation.warmup_hours: Nonnegative finite hours, default 24; 0 disables. Must align with plant and active control intervals. Controllers and plant evolve without resets; all evaluation metrics exclude warm-up. Input histories/forecasts must cover the extended window.
_comments.simulation.cooldown_hours: Controller-active post-roll hours, default 24; 0 disables. Nonnegative, finite and aligned with plant/control intervals. Excluded from every comparison metric, with no state reset or terminal recharge. Mobility and forecasts must cover this period plus twin forecast tails.
_comments.simulation.duration_hours: Scored evaluation hours only, excluding warm-up/cooldown; positive integer multiple of plant timestep.
_comments.simulation.time_step_minutes: Finite positive minutes, divides control interval/horizon and duration. Example: 1.
_comments.simulation.initialization_hours: Must be 0 for matched three-case initialization.
_comments.simulation.ev_trip_file: Explicit NHTS input path for shared/native mobility routines; no legacy-file lookup.
_comments.simulation.NHTS_location_CDIVMSAR_ID: NHTS regional filter integer used by shared cleaning/sampling, example 33.
_comments.simulation.output_directory: New or empty directory for this run. Canonical runner refuses a nonempty directory.
_comments.simulation.random_seed: Nonnegative integer seed; home seed_offset is added for native OCHRE.
_comments.simulation.verbosity: Integer >=7 required to expose tank and HVAC component outputs. Not solver verbosity.
_comments.simulation.numerical_tolerance_kw: Nonnegative numerical validation tolerance in kW.
_comments.simulation.power_balance_tolerance_kw: Nonnegative electrical balance tolerance in kW.
_comments.simulation.maximum_home_power_kw: Positive diagnostic power bound in kW, not a controller constraint.
_comments.simulation.defrost_model: Legacy or Discrete: native/shared equipment defrost model, unrelated to legacy simulator configuration.
_comments.simulation.transformer.overload_capacity: Positive allowable percent of transformer rating; shared static transformer model.
_comments.homes.*.hpxml_file: Existing native OCHRE HPXML envelope/equipment file.
_comments.homes.*.schedule_file: Existing native OCHRE household schedule CSV.
_comments.homes.*.heating_setpoint_c: Finite heating thermostat setpoint, degrees C.
_comments.homes.*.cooling_setpoint_c: Finite cooling setpoint, degrees C, >= heating_setpoint_c.
_comments.homes.*.heating_deadband_c: Positive heating deadband width, degrees C.
_comments.homes.*.cooling_deadband_c: Positive cooling deadband width, degrees C.
_comments.homes.*.heating_deadband_offset: Fraction in [0,1] positioning the heating deadband.
_comments.homes.*.cooling_deadband_offset: Fraction in [0,1] positioning the cooling deadband.
_comments.homes.*.compressor_min_on_time_min: Nonnegative native HVAC minimum-on minutes; HVAC remains pass-through.
_comments.homes.*.backup_setpoint_offset_c: Positive backup setpoint offset, degrees C.
_comments.homes.*.backup_number_of_stages: Positive integer, or explicit null for native selection.
_comments.homes.*.backup_stage_capacities_kw: Positive total kW, descending list of 5/10 kW stages, or explicit null; list length must match stage count.
_comments.homes.*.water_heater_setpoint_c: Physical baseline/native thermostat setpoint, degrees C.
_comments.homes.*.water_heater_deadband_c: Positive degrees C, or explicit null to use native HPXML/equipment value.
_comments.homes.*.water_heater_hp_only: Boolean. True disables resistance water heating in all three cases.
_comments.homes.*.initial_temperature_c: Finite indoor initial degrees C; explicit null retains native randomized initialization.
_comments.homes.*.water_draw_file: Existing water replay CSV path or null for the household schedule. Required for HPWH scenario forecasting.
_comments.homes.*.water_draw_start: ISO datetime selecting replay origin, or null for the replay provider's documented mapping.
_comments.homes.*.save_optimizer_plan_figures: Boolean; save extra per-solve HPWH plan figures.
_comments.homes.*.backed_loads: Nonempty unique list; heat_pump = compressor + fan, excludes resistance. water_heater = entire WH electric demand. Explicit non-EV electrical end-use names also supported; reject overlapping selections or EV/PV/storage.
_comments.homes.*.evs: Map of unique per-home EV IDs. At most one EV may have v2h=true.
_comments.homes.*.evs.*.vehicle_type: sedan, suv or truck (case-insensitive); used by native mobility routines.
_comments.homes.*.evs.*.capacity_kwh: Finite positive beginning-of-life usable capacity, battery-side kWh. Current capacity equals this times SOH.
_comments.homes.*.evs.*.physical.initial_soh: Required fraction in (0,1]; initial usable capacity / beginning-of-life capacity. Existing damage is not billed again.
_comments.homes.*.evs.*.charger_power_kw: Finite positive maximum/rated AC charging kW.
_comments.homes.*.evs.*.initial_soc_fraction: Explicit initial SOC fraction in [0,1] at warm-up start, not evaluation start.
_comments.homes.*.evs.*.work_from_home_probability: NHTS probability in [0,1]; unused for Audi.
_comments.homes.*.evs.*.nom_commute_arrival_time: NHTS nominal arrival HH:MM, or null for sampler inference; unused for Audi.
_comments.homes.*.evs.*.nom_commute_departure_time: NHTS nominal departure HH:MM, or null for sampler inference; unused for Audi.
_comments.homes.*.evs.*.nom_commute_miles: NHTS nominal commute miles, nonnegative or null; unused for Audi.
_comments.homes.*.evs.*.max_commute_distance_var_m: NHTS nonnegative distance variability, miles, or null; unused for Audi.
_comments.homes.*.evs.*.max_commute_times_var_hr: NHTS nonnegative timing variability, hours, or null; unused for Audi.
_comments.homes.*.evs.*.max_roundtrip_miles: NHTS positive maximum roundtrip miles or null; unused for Audi.
_comments.homes.*.evs.*.physical.consumption_kwh_p: Finite positive battery-side driving kWh/km. Trip demand = arrival distance * consumption; SOC change = demand/capacity.
_comments.homes.*.evs.*.physical.max_discharge_kw: Finite nonnegative AC inverter/discharge rating; must be positive for V2H. Actual discharge also capped by selected realized backed loads.
_comments.homes.*.evs.*.physical.v2h: Boolean capability. All-baseline and twin disable discharge; advanced enables only when EV MPC is selected.
_comments.homes.*.evs.*.mobility.source_file: Required existing dataset path. NHTS is cleaned in code; Audi uses pre-cleaned arrival_distance_km, never net SOC as driving demand.
_comments.homes.*.evs.*.mobility.source_vehicle: Audi vehicle identifier string, or null for seeded selection. NHTS uses its seeded trip sampler; this field must be null.
_comments.homes.*.evs.*.mobility.seed: Nonnegative integer fixed mobility seed, independent per EV.
_comments.homes.*.evs.*.mobility.history_days: Nonnegative requested past coverage days. Audi chooses a seeded feasible interior point with future coverage, never wraps; NHTS wraps its annual realization.
_comments.homes.*.evs.*.physical.battery_replaceme: Nonnegative gross new battery $/usable kWh; user-selected 119. Pack price need not equal installed replacement cost.
_comments.homes.*.evs.*.physical.battery_residual_: Residual $/usable kWh at economic EOL, between zero and replacement cost; default zero.
_comments.homes.*.evs.*.physical.calibration_end_o: Fraction in (0,1); default 0.8. reference_cycle_count reaches THIS endpoint, independent of the monetary fade budget.
_comments.homes.*.evs.*.physical.end_of_life_soh: Economic endpoint in (0,1); default 0.7 gives a 30% capacity-loss budget. Extrapolates the calibrated additive fade slope, without recalibration.
_comments.homes.*.evs.*.physical.reference_cycle_d: Reference full-cycle depth in (0,1]; default 0.8, Mathews NMC calibration.
_comments.homes.*.evs.*.physical.reference_mean_so: Reference mean SOC in [depth/2,1-depth/2]; default 0.6. Reference stress uses signed mean minus reference SOC.
_comments.homes.*.evs.*.physical.reference_cycle_c: Positive full cycles to calibration_end_of_life_soh at reference depth/mean; default 3000 to 80%. Economic life scales by (1-economic EOL)/(1-calibration EOL): default 4500 cycles, shared by all costs.
_comments.homes.*.evs.*.physical.rainflow_exponent: Convex NMC depth-stress exponent >=1; default 2.03. Fade coefficient = (1-calibration_end_of_life_soh)/(reference_cycle_count*reference_cycle_depth**exponent).
_comments.homes.*.evs.*.physical.soc_stress_coeffi: Nonnegative signed exponential SOC stress coefficient, default 1.04 retained as a modeling assumption; exp(k*(mean_soc-reference_mean_soc)), not absolute deviation. Applies only to reference metrics.
